description: Source code for LayerProtoParser class in Android's surfaceflinger service, responsible for parsing and representing layer tree structures from protocol buffer data.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::LayerTree
classes.description: Represents a tree of layers with top-level layers and all layers.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::Layer
classes.description: Represents a single layer with properties like position, size, color, and hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::Region
classes.description: Represents a region composed of multiple rectangles.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::Rect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with left, top, right, bottom coordinates.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::FloatRect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with floating point coordinates.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::ActiveBuffer
classes.description: Represents an active buffer with dimensions and format.

methods.name: sortLayers
methods.description: Comparison function to sort layers based on layerStack, z, and id.

methods.name: generateLayerTree
methods.description: Creates a layer tree from a proto representation, identifying top-level layers.

methods.name: generateLayerList
methods.description: Generates a list of layers from proto data, building parent-child relationships.

methods.name: generateLayer
methods.description: Creates a Layer object from a LayerProto message.

methods.name: generateRegion
methods.description: Creates a Region from a RegionProto message.

methods.name: generateRect
methods.description: Creates a Rect from a RectProto message.

methods.name: generateFloatRect
methods.description: Creates a FloatRect from a FloatRectProto message.

methods.name: generateTransform
methods.description: Creates a Transform from a TransformProto message.

methods.name: generateActiveBuffer
methods.description: Creates an ActiveBuffer from an ActiveBufferProto message.

methods.name: updateChildrenAndRelative
methods.description: Updates parent, children, relatives, and z-order relationships for a layer.

methods.name: layerTreeToString
methods.description: Converts a LayerTree to a string representation.

methods.name: layerToString
methods.description: Converts a Layer to a string, including its properties and hierarchy.
